title: Nutty Silky Indian Long Beans Curry
description: A creamy, nutty curry that turns crisp Chinese long beans into a silky delight, perfect for midnight cravings and Whole30-friendly meals.
instructions: Trim and cut the Chinese long beans into 2-inch pieces.
Toast the whole almonds in a dry skillet over medium heat until lightly browned, then set aside to cool.
Heat coconut oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and sauté until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Stir in minced garlic and grated ginger, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the diced tomatoes, ground cumin, coriander, turmeric, and chili powder; cook for 3-4 minutes until tomatoes soften.
Pour in 1 cup of water and bring the mixture to a gentle simmer.
Add the prepared long beans, reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 10-12 minutes until beans are tender yet crisp.
Stir in the toasted almonds, season with salt, and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Remove from heat, garnish with fresh coriander leaves if desired, and serve hot with a side of roasted cauliflower or a simple salad.
